visual_observations: Adult anime appearance and recognizable A1 face, silver-gray grouped hair, ring clip, gray-blue eyes, studs, low relaxed hands and slight weight shift are closely preserved.
Entire head, both hands and both ankle boots are inside the frame with clear margins.
Graphite sleeveless dress, sculptural ivory collar and offset wrap panel, restrained teal seams, utility belt and integrated hip pocket provide a distinct soft-future silhouette.
Garment structure, anatomy and pale quiet background are coherent; no text or extra subject visible.
deviations: Detached sleeves extend from above the elbows rather than forearms only.
Several visible sleeve/boot fasteners exceed the requested two or three; boots retain a modest block heel instead of a uniformly low sole.
